name: german-history-site
description: Source-critical interactive website generated from the German history knowledge base (../).

scripts.dev: npm run content && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev
scripts.build: npm run content && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && pagefind --site dist
scripts.build:public: npm run content && PUBLIC_BUILD=1 ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --outDir dist-public
